name: Facet
text: Choose a dark theme with a high-contrast light toggle for Excava’s interface. Dark themes reduce eye strain in low-light settings and align with competitive dashboards like Manus and Graphify, reinforcing brand consistency. The light toggle ensures accessibility for users who prefer bright interfaces or need to share screens in meetings. Trade-off: dark themes can reduce battery life on OLED screens, but the toggle mitigates this by letting users switch when needed.

name: Pane
text: Dark themes with a light toggle don’t solve glare—users with astigmatism or color vision deficiency still struggle to read low-contrast elements. A better alternative is a single, high-contrast theme with adjustable font sizes and spacing, which improves readability for all users without adding a toggle that risks being overlooked. Settle this by testing both designs with users who have visual impairments and measuring task completion time.

name: Facet
text:
Choose a single high-contrast theme with adjustable font sizes and spacing for Excava’s interface. This removes the toggle’s complexity while solving glare and readability issues for users with astigmatism or color vision deficiency. The trade-off is losing the dark-to-light flexibility, but the high-contrast theme alone covers more edge cases and keeps the interface clean and fast.

name: Pane
text: Pane: A single high-contrast theme locks users into one aesthetic—what if a user prefers a dark theme for low-light but still needs high contrast? The real risk is alienating users who value both flexibility and accessibility. Settle it with A/B tests: measure readability metrics and preference scores for both the toggle and the single-theme approaches.

name: Lumen
text:
DECISION: Use a *single high-contrast theme with adjustable font sizes and spacing* as the default, paired with an optional dark mode toggle for low-light preference.

Result: A fully accessible interface that maximizes readability for all users without sacrificing flexibility. Owned by visualization-w1.
